title: Jets S Minkah Fitzpatrick will appeal fine for hit on Browns WR KC Concepcion

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets S Minkah Fitzpatrick will appeal fine for hit on Browns WR KC Concepcion
sources.description: Jets safety Minkah Fitzpatrick said he received a fine from the NFL for a hit that concussed Browns wide receiver KC Concepcion on Sunday.
